description: ML Model service that runs ONNX, OpenVINO IR, TFLite, TensorFlow and PaddlePaddle models on Intel CPU, iGPU, Arc GPU and NPU via the OpenVINO runtime (Linux and Windows), plus a YOLO detection vision service.

models.short_description: Run ML models with the OpenVINO runtime on Intel CPU, GPU and NPU.
YOLO v5/v8/v11 decoding and NMS on top of any mlmodel service.
Device discovery, compiled-model properties, benchmarking and latency stats.
